questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in HTML?
questions.explanation: In HTML, <!-- --> marks a comment. Block comments use -->.

questions.question: What is the difference between class and id?
options: class can repeat on many elements; id must be unique
questions.correctAnswer: class can repeat on many elements; id must be unique
questions.explanation: id = one per page; class = reusable groups.
